scope: Read-only audit of CPU coverage, actual metrics, selection rationale, task timing boundaries, false-completion negatives and external gaps in parent-authored summary/builder/report.

independence.limitation: This is independent review of parent-authored delivery claims, not an independent recertification of the CPU RTL authored in this lane. Separate non-author SoC review is linked.

findings.problem: Initial W2 L2 candidate inherited two-task CPU scope despite all actual W2 CPU compilations using READ_LATENCY=1.
findings.fix: Final draft marks W2 L2 NOT_RUN_CPU_L2; all other L2 CPU profiles NOT_RUN; D2/D3 PM4/PM2 CPU scopes are explicitly L1.

findings.problem: Initial narrative called the retained Icarus negative batch timed out; actual batch was deliberately aborted after detecting an inadequate later runtime cap, and remained failed/incomplete.
findings.fix: Final narrative accurately says aborted due runtime-cap inadequacy and excluded, with successful later real Verilator controls retained.

checks.evidence: Default D3 PM4/L1 has core36 and twelve independent frozen-layer CPU tasks in six two-task boots; W2 PM4/L1 is a two-full-task Pareto alternative, not claimed physically optimal.
Same-case/tool/image/actual indexed output comparisons linked from final handoff; W2 C differs only by namespace and legal START timing.
D3 twelve tasks are one engineering input and six boots, not a continuous encoder or official12; CPU36 is not run; W1 CPU and every CPU L2 are NOT_RUN; W2 CPU is two full tasks plus directed flags.

Inclusive phase-marker to final actual shared Y/flag write response; includes per-task layer/shift/address descriptors, all X/W/bias loading and CPU/ICB stalls; excludes boot, pre-marker global M/N/count reads, host image installation and preprocessing. W2 core window includes parameter-supply overlap and is not equated to isolated compute latency.

Positive coverage checks every real CPU SRAM Y/flag write, index, uniqueness and actual responses; terminal success follows last response. Real correct-return-zero no-work and skip-final-store controls fail coverage. D3 and W2 directed flags cover neither/overflow-only/saturation-only/both, last flags5/7; wrong-overflow expected-bit controls fail actual flag writes.

Official600/selected12/platform equivalence, designated macro/cell models, 150MHz STA, mapped-equivalence, area<=2.25mm2 and full-SoC energy remain unresolved/NOT_RUN. No formal score, area/energy winner, physical optimum or contest acceptance claimed.
